summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting the results of DeFi Technologies Inc.'s 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of shareholders. It discloses the election of directors, appointment of auditors, approval of a share consolidation, and amendments to corporate by-laws. The meeting was held on June 29, 2026, with 31.77% of shares voted. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. The results are routine corporate governance matters typical of an annual meeting.
